idea: Content and marketing service for architecture practices
pain: Practices have no time or skill for marketing
v1: Three months of content for one practice
verdict: Recurring and warm, but low fees from the poorest buyer and it uses none of her scarce skill.

why.distribution: Warmest possible channel - she is one of them.
why.demand: Practices do hire marketing help, usually cheaply.
why.fmf: Uses her writing and design taste but almost none of her rare financial or AI expertise.
why.revenue_structure: Monthly retainers that renew by habit.
why.defensibility: Marketing agencies and freelancers are everywhere.
why.ceiling: £1,500/mo x 11 practices = £198k, far beyond what this segment pays and beyond her delivery capacity.

ceiling_arithmetic: £1,500/mo x 11 retained practices = £198k. Eleven concurrent content retainers is a small agency, not a solo part-time founder, and practices at this size typically pay £500-800. Realistic: 3-4 at £800 = £29-38k.
carries: Recurring revenue from the warmest channel she has.
kills: It wastes her advantage. Anyone can do this, and the buyer pays accordingly.
